subject.title: [Feature]: Visible agent-to-agent messaging for ACP thread-bound sessions (proxy-only delivery without main session creation)

question: Which public contract should OpenClaw support for visible coordinator-to-ACP-thread instructions without creating main Discord session metadata?
rationale: The code can support several narrow fixes, but selecting between a sessions_send extension, a proxy-only message send, or an ACP-bound-thread exclusion changes public API semantics, compatibility behavior, and security boundaries.

options.title: Define Narrow Visible ACP Send
options.body: Add an explicit `sessions_send`-style visible delivery mode scoped to authorized ACP-bound sessions and prove it does not create unintended main-session metadata.

options.title: Define Proxy-Only Message Send
options.body: Add a `message` or gateway-send bypass for authorized proxy delivery while preserving normal outbound mirroring for every other send path.

options.title: Decline Core API For Now
options.body: Keep the workaround/plugin direction and document that current core does not support proxy-visible ACP coordination without session metadata side effects.

recommendation.title: Define Narrow Visible ACP Send
recommendation.body: Add an explicit `sessions_send`-style visible delivery mode scoped to authorized ACP-bound sessions and prove it does not create unintended main-session metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger is the strongest available routing owner from the sessions_send and outbound mirroring feature history.
